name: Calculate and convert specific dates and time values
description: Users asked to calculate specific dates, convert time formats, determine durations between points in time, or explain historical and cultural calendar systems. The requests varied from simple arithmetic on standard calendars to complex conversions involving Julian dates, Unix timestamps, and non-Gregorian systems like the Mayan or Hindu calendars.
